name: Jumping Jacks
steps: Stand upright with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump while opening legs to shoulder width and bringing arms overhead.
Jump back to starting position and repeat the movement fluidly.
tips: Land softly on the balls of your feet to protect your joints.
Keep core engaged throughout the exercise.

name: Burpees
steps: From an upright position, squat down and place hands on the floor.
Kick feet back into a high plank position.
Perform a pushup (optional), jump feet back into squat, and explode upward with arms raised.
tips: Keep core tight to prevent hips from sagging in plank.
Maintain a steady rhythm without stopping abruptly.

name: Mountain Climbers
steps: Set up in high plank with hands directly beneath shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest while keeping back flat.
Alternate legs quickly as if running in place.
tips: Do not raise hips too high.
Distribute weight evenly between hands and toes.

name: High Knees
steps: Stand upright with feet hip-width apart.
Run in place driving knees up alternately to hip height.
Pump your arms vigorously in rhythm with legs.
tips: Keep torso tall without leaning backward.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.

name: Abdominal Crunches
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place hands behind head or crossed over chest.
Curl torso upward lifting shoulder blades off the floor, focusing on contracting abs.
tips: Do not pull on your neck with your hands.
Exhale as you lift and squeeze abs at the top.

name: Plank
steps: Place forearms on floor aligned under shoulders.
Extend legs back resting on toes.
Maintain a straight line from head to heels.
tips: Squeeze glutes and abdominals to keep spine neutral.
Breathe steadily throughout the hold.

name: Bicycle Crunches
steps: Lie on your back with hands behind head and legs elevated at 90 degrees.
Bring right elbow toward left knee while extending right leg.
Alternate sides in a fluid pedaling motion.
tips: Rotate from the ribcage, not just moving elbows.
Keep lower back pressed against the floor.

name: Bodyweight Squats
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Push hips back and bend knees as if sitting back into a chair.
Lower until thighs are parallel to floor, then drive through heels to return.
tips: Keep chest lifted and gaze forward.
Ensure knees track in line with toes.

name: Lunges
steps: Take a large step forward with one leg.
Lower body until both knees form 90-degree angles.
Push through front foot to return to start and switch legs.
tips: Front knee should not excessively travel past toes.
Keep torso upright throughout the movement.

name: Glute Bridges
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat near glutes.
Drive through heels to lift hips toward ceiling.
Squeeze glutes at top for a second, then lower slowly.
tips: Do not hyperextend lower back at the top.
Keep shoulders grounded on the floor.

name: Pushups
steps: Place hands on floor slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower body keeping elbows at 45 degrees until chest nearly touches floor.
Push forcefully into floor to return to start.
tips: Maintain a straight line from shoulders to ankles.
Modify on knees if standard pushups are too strenuous.

name: Pike Pushups
steps: Assume an inverted V position with hips raised, legs and arms straight.
Bend elbows lowering crown of head toward floor ahead of hands.
Push back and up to return to the inverted V.
tips: Focus power on shoulders (deltoids).
Keep eyes focused toward your feet.

name: Tricep Dips
steps: Place hands on edge of a bench, chair, or floor behind hips.
Extend legs forward and bend elbows to 90 degrees lowering hips.
Push arms straight to return to top, contracting triceps.
tips: Keep back close to the support surface.
Do not strain shoulder joint by dipping past 90 degrees.
